messages:
Chris: Heads up - AWS sandbox account 67890 shows as provisioned in the publisher portal but no SKUs/trials visible. Anyone run into this specific mismatch?
Priya: saw similar before. usually an IAM propagation or publisher-role policy missing. grabbing logs now.
Priya: logs show: `AccessDenied: marketplace:ListEntitlements denied for arn:aws:sts::67890:assumed-role/OnboardLambdaRole` when onboarding worker calls the entitlement API.
Mike P: that indicates MarketplacePublisherRole attachment likely didn't finish before we ran the entitlement call. we should add idempotent retries in onboarding orchestration + a short wait for IAM propagation.
Chris: can we avoid a manual delist if SKUs arrive later? want to keep UI consistent.
Anika: legal note: if the portal briefly lists SKUs without localized EULA links set for EU regions, compliance requires delisting. So better to block publish until EULA fields are present.
Sam: ops/devex mitigation: include a gating check in the publish pipeline that verifies entitlements + EULA metadata. quick terraform snippet for partners to validate locally: `provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" } resource "aws_iam_role" "mp_role" { name = "MarketplacePublisherRole" }` with instructions to run assume-role and `aws marketplace-entitlement list-entitlements --product-code redwood-enterprise`.
Priya: I'm going to run a manual assume-role test now:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::67890:role/MarketplacePublisherRole --role-session-name test
aws marketplace-entitlement --profile assumed list-entitlements --product-code "redwood-enterprise"
```
Priya: manual test fails with 403. Redeploying role attach and will re-run.
Mike P: i'll add a retry loop in the onboarding lambda so it retries ListEntitlements up to 6 times with exponential backoff, and emit a monitoring metric if still failing. I'll also add a short IAM-policy-attach verification step to ensure the MarketplacePublisherRole exists and has required actions.
marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-4201: "Sandbox acct 67890 - entitlements API 403 during onboarding" assigned to cloudops. https://issues.redwood.com/MP-4201
Laura: Product packaging hold - I'll pause publish checklist until MP-4201 resolved and EULA links confirmed.
Anika: EULA URLs for manifest: https://redwood.com/legal/eula-en, https://redwood.com/legal/eula-fr, https://redwood.com/legal/eula-de. Also confirm data residency flag for Azure/GCP flows; we'll need that in listing metadata.
Sam: I'll add a short troubleshooting doc to partners repo: steps: 1) confirm role attachment, 2) assume-role and call list-entitlements, 3) verify product-code in listing metadata, 4) check EULA locale entries. Include command snippets.
Chris: action items: Priya update MP-4201 with logs and ETA; Mike roll out retry + monitoring; Anika ensure EULA + residency flags in manifest; Sam commit troubleshooting doc; Laura hold publish until green. Follow-up here tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
